annotations.title: Dub a video into other languages

description: Full automatic dubbing of an uploaded video: transcribe once, translate, voice every target language with its own voice and render a dubbed video per language. Each language returns an audio_url (voice track aligned to the original timeline - upload it to YouTube Studio as a multi-language audio track) and a final_video_url. Takes several minutes: returns job_guids immediately; poll get_localization_status. Confirm the cost with estimate_video_localization for long videos. Several characters (drama, film, interview)? Set multi_speaker = true: speakers are detected on the whole video and each one can get its own voice - pass speaker_voices per target if you already know them, otherwise the job pauses with current_step WaitingSpeakerVoices and get_localization_status lists the speakers with sample lines; ask the user which voice fits each character, then call set_speaker_voices.

multi_speaker.description: Dub each character with its own voice. Speakers are detected on the whole video (labels 0, 1, 2... in order of appearance).

original_audio_volume_percent.description: Keep the original sound (music/effects) under the new voice at this volume in the dubbed video. 0 = remove.

source_language.description: Spoken language of the video, e.g. vi.

speaker_voice_step.description: multi_speaker without speaker_voices: pause for voice choice after transcription (srt) or after translation (translated, shows translated sample lines).

targets.description: One entry per target language (the server allows 10 per job by default).

language.description: Target language code, e.g. en, es, ja.

speaker_voices.description: multi_speaker only: voice per speaker for this language, e.g. {"0": "v1:...", "1": "v1:..."}.

voice.description: Voice token (v1:...) for that language from list_voices / favorites / custom voices. With multi_speaker it is the default voice for speakers without their own.
